# Tally Baseball

> A free, spoiler-safe companion for scoring a baseball game by hand. It shows
> lineups, substitutions, umpires, rosters and statistics from the public MLB
> Stats API, and keeps every score sealed until the reader taps to reveal it —
> so a game can be followed live, or watched hours late, without being spoiled.
> It is not a data-entry tool: the reader keeps score on paper.

No account is required and nothing is behind a paywall. The app runs in a
browser and installs to a phone home screen.

A note on this file: the evidence that answer engines request llms.txt is weak,
and Google has said it does not support it. It is here because it is cheap and
occasionally useful, not because anything depends on it. The guides below are
server-rendered HTML and are the authoritative source — they need no JavaScript
to read.

## Guides

- [How to score a baseball game](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/learn/score-a-baseball-game): The beginner's guide — the scorecard grid, the nine position numbers, the symbols, and a worked half-inning.
- [Scorekeeping symbols and position numbers](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/learn/scorekeeping-symbols): The complete notation reference, including where scorers legitimately disagree.
- [Choosing a baseball scorebook](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/learn/choose-a-scorebook): What differs between paper scorebooks, and which suits which kind of scorer.
- [Watching a game on delay without spoilers](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/learn/watch-without-spoilers): What actually leaks a score, and how to follow a game you are watching later.
- [Keeping score at the ballpark](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/learn/score-at-the-ballpark): What to bring, where to sit, and the substitutions you will miss from a stadium seat.
- [Ballpark passports](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/learn/ballpark-passports): How ballpark stamp books work, and keeping a record of the games you saw.
- [How to read a box score](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/learn/read-a-box-score): Every column in a box score and a line score, explained.
- [Baseball stats glossary](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/learn/stats-glossary): Plain-language definitions from batting average through WAR, with rough scales.

## The app

- [Today's games](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/): The slate, with every score sealed until revealed.
- [Leaders](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/leaders): Season leaderboards. Stat lines are never sealed — a season line is not a score.
- [Standings](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/standings)
- [Game Log](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/logbook): A stamp for each game you saw, arranged in books by hand.
- [About](https://bbsbh.vercel.app/about)
